clauses.reason: whole: EO 11559 (signed 1970-09-18, 35 FR 14687) creates an emergency board under section 10 of the Railway Labor Act; its only commands are the board's creation, the thirty-day reporting command ("the disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.") and the standstill ("from this date and for thirty days after the Board has made its report"). The report deadline and the standstill are spent facts and are not ends (owner ruling 2026-10-21 report-deadline, option C); no board report is registered in this packet, so no report date is claimed. First end: EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25), whose operative sentence reads "it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and" and "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" followed by a two-column 'No. Subject' table; the table entry at offset 25100 of the held EO_12553.txt reads "11559 Creating an emergency board to investigate railroad labor disputes", which matches this order's number and subject. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1986-02-25 (the Federal Register printing date, 1986-03-03, is not used). The Office of the Federal Register catalog note for this order reads "Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986".
